mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sensor_reading (scenario_id, sensor_id, gas_type, concentration, unit, sampled_at, source, quality_status, raw_payload) VALUES (#{scenarioId}, #{sensorId}, #{gasType}, #{concentration}, #{unit}, #{sampledAt}, #{source}, #{qualityStatus}, #{rawPayload})
mapper.select: SELECT id, scenario_id as scenarioId, sensor_id as sensorId, gas_type as gasType, concentration, unit, sampled_at as sampledAt, received_at as receivedAt, source, quality_status as qualityStatus, raw_payload as rawPayload FROM sensor_reading ORDER BY sampled_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, scenario_id as scenarioId, sensor_id as sensorId, gas_type as gasType, concentration, unit, sampled_at as sampledAt, received_at as receivedAt, source, quality_status as qualityStatus, raw_payload as rawPayload FROM sensor_reading ORDER BY sampled_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, scenario_id as scenarioId, sensor_id as sensorId, gas_type as gasType, concentration, unit, sampled_at as sampledAt, received_at as receivedAt, source, quality_status as qualityStatus, raw_payload as rawPayload FROM sensor_reading WHERE sensor_id = #{sensorId} ORDER BY sampled_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
